name: Dueling Armor
body:
Price 24,200 gp; Slot armor; CL 9th; Weight 20 lbs.; Aura moderate illusion and transmutation

DESCRIPTION

The wearer of these +2 armored coats gain a +2 enhancement bonus on initiative checks and a +2 circumstance bonus on attacks of opportunity if the attacks are made with a dueling sword.

Once per day when the wearer of dueling armor is the target of a melee attack, she can make an attack with a dueling sword as an immediate action. If the result of her attack roll is higher than that of her attacker, the wearer of dueling armor parries the attack and takes no damage.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 12,200 gp; Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor; Spells cat’s grace, symbol of striking
